{{Top|leg|canon=Void-droid}}
A '''Void Droid''' was a master-less [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that suffered from a lack of maintenance and [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] to the point that it went insane. Void Droids often joined up with fellow malfunctioning droids to form roving bands. To survive, such groups were forced to scavenge and steal power and replacement parts; some Void Droids even became violent toward mundane droids out of desperate need for [[Lubricant/Legends|lubricant]] and other hardware. Void Droids were associated with the wreckage of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. One such group inhabited a chunk of wreckage from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] destroyed [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The droids encountered a band of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[operative]]s and their [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Spilferithimus-narlamos|guide]] sometime before [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].
